records.region: Rio de Janeiro; upper Imbé valley, Lagoa de Cima, lowland drainage south-west of Campos dos Goytacazes, Lagoa Feia and Barra do Furado coastal setting
records.candidate_name_role: Supported named upper-river candidate; incomplete connected-system correspondence
records.material_pending_reason: The acquired originals do not establish the selected northerly middle-valley side passage, the east outlet of Lagoa de Cima through the intervening lowland river corridor, or the full northeastern Lagoa Feia-margin to coastal through-route. These are ordinary connected-channel correspondence gaps, not requests for exact banks, current flows, gate-operation labels or one uniform hydronym.
records.geographic_disambiguation: The named Imbé upper valley and lower approach toward Lagoa de Cima are supported. The Quissamã municipal map also prints Rio do Imbé on a northern Lagoa Feia inflow, but the unestablished intervening through-links do not justify extending that label across the whole selected system.
records.completion_scope: All 32 parts of the one supplied mainstem were considered against the acquired municipal/state originals and the independently issued Imbé basin study. Several named reaches, both lake settings and the Atlantic receiving coast are identified; connected whole-feature correspondence remains incomplete.
records.supported_name_scope: Named river reaches only. Lagoa de Cima and Lagoa Feia retain their separate lake identities. The locality label Canal das Flechas is not treated as proof that every selected lowland segment bears that channel name. Ururaí remains an unconfirmed route-name lead in this finding because the relevant article was not acquired and discovery snippets are excluded.

scope_limits: No complete whole-system natural hydronym or official registry record is established.
The ordinary-scale gaps involve actual selected route alternatives and missing mapped continuity, not a requirement for exact vertices or a single name throughout connected reaches.
Historic reservoir and drainage descriptions are limited to their stated geography and date. Upstream Trajano reservoir context is not assigned to this selected opening without correspondence.
No modern gate operation, water-level, navigability, discharge, tidal condition or exact coastline position was researched.
No further acquisition followed the final atlas failure; stopped and unread publications do not contribute geographic evidence.

bounded_name_observations.name: Rio do Imbé
bounded_name_observations.scope: Directly supported named upper reaches and separately printed northern Feia inflow; missing intervening links prevent a completed system identity.
Distinct mapped lake settings; selected outlet and margin-to-coast through-links remain incomplete.

records.region: San Pedro de Atacama and Salar de Atacama, Antofagasta Region, northern Chile.
records.candidate_name_role: No supported whole selected-system natural-river identity. Jorquencal or Escalera, Puritama and Vilama identify bounded upper components; Salar de Atacama identifies the downstream surface and actual selected terminal.
records.material_pending_reason: Two genuine through-link gaps remain: the chosen northeastern opening before the mapped Jorquencal or Escalera channel, and the landward transfer from the Vilama vicinity across the lower Chaxa approach to the northern salar margin.
records.geographic_disambiguation: The selection approaches the Jorquencal or Escalera corridor from the northeast, follows the Puritama and Vilama receiving setting, departs toward an unproved eastern and southern connector, and crosses Salar de Atacama to an interior terminal. The separately mapped San Pedro drainage does not provide a substitute for the selected headward or landward route.
records.completion_scope: Bounded source research is finished with one material-pending primary state. Every stored part and actual terminal has been considered. The salar surface and selected interior terminal are established, while the opening and landward connector prevent completed full-selection correspondence. These are not merely unnamed reaches of an otherwise fully established river.
records.supported_name_scope: Upper named channel components only; the downstream salt-flat name applies to the mapped salar surface, not a uniform river name.

scope_limits: The unsupported northeastern opening cannot be replaced by nearby mapped tributaries or by a conventional river-source account.
The selected landward Vilama-to-Chaxa-to-salar transfer remains unproved; no dry wash or managed diversion is assumed to close it.
The source-specific upper hydronym placements do not establish exact official transition vertices.
The selected endpoint is on the source-identified Salar de Atacama surface; its present water condition, hydraulic significance and lowest-point status are unverified.
No whole-route natural river name, formal registry identity, Korean name, exact banks, flow permanence or operating details are established.

bounded_name_observations.scope: Separately source-labelled upper components; neither the unresolved opening nor long salar-interior route is assigned a uniform river name.

bounded_name_observations.name: Salar de Atacama
bounded_name_observations.scope: Mapped downstream salt-flat surface and actual interior terminal, not a named river mouth or proof of present inundation.

records.region: Western Devon Island, Qikiqtaaluk, Nunavut, Canada; inland northwestward drainage toward the Wellington Channel coast north of Dragleybeck Inlet.
records.material_pending_reason: The selected opening, upper and middle course, intermediate joins, northern turn, any local waterbody or terrain passages, lower outlet approach and actual terminal branch remain without continuous source correspondence. The failure concerns missing useful cartography, not a requirement for surveyed banks, exact flow mechanics or proof of under-ice channels.
records.completion_scope: Bounded source search finished with all25 stored parts of FID2298 considered. Only broad coastal setting and regional scientific context were established. No primary inland map pixels were inspected, so neither representative-system completion nor a completed naming-scope hold is claimed.
records.supported_name_scope: No river name is supported for the selected course. Coastal inlet and bay labels are contextual place names and are not assigned to the drainage.

scope_limits: Absence of a supported candidate in this bounded pass does not establish that the river lacks a local or official name.
No independent evidence yet distinguishes the selected inland water/terrain connections or final outlet.
Historical geological bibliography and broad scientific setting are insufficient for geographic completion.

records.material_pending_reason: Independent source correspondence for the western opening and initial easterly channel. Readable corridor evidence for the partly label-obscured northern bend and its joins. Evidence of the middle transfer and passage through the scattered-lagoon terrain near Caleufú. Evidence of the selected southern approach to the Chadilauquen sector and continuation farther east. Identification and geographic correspondence of the actual eastern terminal, including any lake or depression entry.
records.geographic_disambiguation: No representative river-system or selected-reach name is established. Sistema Hídrico Embajador Martini and Laguna Chadilauquen are regional context only; neither is assigned to the selected river or actual terminal.
records.completion_scope: This bounded research pass is closed with materially incomplete source correspondence. Thematic-map availability and regional names do not turn unresolved through-links into a completed name-scope hold. No further acquisition is active.
records.supported_name_scope: No representative river-system or selected-reach name is established. Sistema Hídrico Embajador Martini and Laguna Chadilauquen are regional context only; neither is assigned to the selected river or actual terminal.

scope_limits: The modeled selection may cross diffuse runoff, closed depressions, intermittent passages or managed links, but the inspected evidence does not classify each selected interval.
The recognized regional-system label cannot substitute for source correspondence along the entire selected river.
No absence-of-name claim, formal registry match or Korean name is established.
The remaining gaps concern ordinary geographic and channel correspondence, not exact banks, vertices, current water levels or management operations.

bounded_name_observations.name: Laguna Chadilauquen
bounded_name_observations.scope: A named regional lagoon west of the selected actual terminal; no river-name or terminal assignment.

bounded_name_observations.name: Sistema Hídrico Embajador Martini
bounded_name_observations.scope: Regional context around Chadilauquen; not proof of the selected western course or eastern continuation.

reconstruction_rule: Start from the pinned r46 cumulative index and apply later append-only deltas in verified commit order, rejecting duplicate IDs. Keep base records, scope clauses, region qualifiers and assessment histories unchanged. Apply explicit status-list changes. Subtract all recorded IDs from the exact eligible initial inventory to recover unrecorded targets; pending IDs remain recorded but are not completed source reviews.
publication_boundary: Own factual name/scope findings, public official URLs, bounded geometry metadata and public continuity pins only. No original maps, crops, complete coordinates or private source/derivative/registration fingerprints. Official hosting does not establish source redistribution rights.

research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes. Preserve original queue IDs and ranks for continuity; apply documented geographic deferrals without counting them as name research, and place deferred objects into their corrected later phase by length-descending, stable-ID order. Prior candidate and scope-held assessments remain unresolved where stated.
